name: second-read
description: Checks what Claude Code posts through git, gh and GitHub tools for private details, and refuses the call when it finds one.

model_check.title: Model check
model_check.description: After the word check passes a post, a small model reads it beside your turns in the conversation and refuses it if it carries what you said in private. It sends both to the model provider this session uses, and counts toward your usage limit or API billing.

model.title: Model check's model
model.description: The model the model check runs, as claude --model takes it.
